brief.title: 知己 · 健康手记
brief.summary: A local personal health journal that keeps medical records, Apple Health exports, and daily meals in one place.
brief.summaryZh: 装在自己电脑上的个人健康档案：整理病历和检查单，也把日常三餐和 Apple 健康记录放在同一天里看。

entries.title: 知己 · 健康手记
entries.summary: Health Journal is a Chinese-first, local personal health tool. In v1.6, it puts Apple Health ZIP/XML exports and daily meals side by side, trims the 12-item sidebar down to two focused sections (Daily Log and Medical Records), adds native DeepSeek API support, and polishes both code reliability and interface copy. Your files stay on your machine, AI calls ask before sending anything, and the tool never diagnoses or prescribes.
entries.summaryZh: 一款装在本地、中文界面的个人健康记录工具。v1.6 把 Apple 健康导出的步数、睡眠和日常饮食放到同一天里看，把原来铺开的 12 个侧边栏入口收拢成「日常记录」和「医疗档案」两大块，补齐了 DeepSeek 官方 API 适配，也把前后端状态和界面文案重头打磨了一遍。资料留在自己设备上，AI 只在你点确认后才发数据，不看病、不开药。

sections.title: 它用来解决什么问题
items: 去医院复诊时，化验单、病历、吃过的药和最近的作息饮食往往散在微信、相册和纸质单据里。这个工具把它们收在本地，方便平时随手记、复诊前拉出一页就医摘要。
打开默认是空白档案，只给自己用。设备导出的数据、自己写的感受、原件里的事实和 AI 整理的草稿都分开标清楚，没记的就留空，不硬凑。

sections.title: 主要功能
items: 日常手记与独立记餐：按天把早中晚餐、加餐和当天的步数、睡眠、心率、步行距离并排看。想记一餐直接写、顺手贴张照片就行，不用先做餐单，也不必调 AI。
Apple 健康导入：支持读取苹果健康导出的官方 ZIP/XML，覆盖 18 类常见日常指标。先预览、自己勾选指标和日期再入库，不同设备的数据不会硬加在一起，缺了哪天就留空。
精简的两块主导航：把原来一长串 12 个侧边栏入口收拢成「日常记录」（日常手记、AI 助理）和「医疗档案」（档案总览、诊疗与资料、就医摘要），「设置与模型」挪到底部，老路由和书签照常可用。
可选的 AI 帮手与 DeepSeek 适配：内置 DeepSeek 官方预设（支持 deepseek-flash 图文和 deepseek-v4-pro 纯文字），也兼容 OpenAI、百炼、硅基流动、自定义 API 和本地 Codex。每次外发资料前都会先给你看发什么、等你确认，生成的整理结果只算草稿。
本地备份与手机随身资料版：桌面端数据存成 SQLite 和附件目录，支持备份恢复（schema v4 / 备份 v4）；手机端有独立的加密资料版，出门拍照存单据，回家再手动和电脑互传。

sections.title: 这次 v1.6 更新了什么
items: 导航大瘦身：结合朋友试用的真实反馈，把 12 个平铺入口归拢为「日常记录」和「医疗档案」两大板块，页内用子标签切换；模型设置退到底部，默认露出常用的 API Key，本地 Codex 折叠收起。
日常手记与 Apple 健康导入：延续当天合并进来的 Apple 健康 ZIP/XML 导入和独立记餐，可以按天对照活动、休息与三餐并关联照片（无需 Apple ID，也不是实时同步）。
完整适配 DeepSeek 官方 API：加入 DeepSeek 预设，处理纯文字 content 格式、关闭默认思考模式并开启 JSON 输出与更长超时，把 402 余额不足、404 模型名和空响应等报错说清楚。
代码与界面全面打磨：排查了前后端并发锁、嵌套数据库连接、删除记录后的空态和失效数据来源重置；全站统一为更耐看的松绿/灰白配色，去掉偏口号的 AI 腔文案，同时修好了手机窄屏排版。

sections.title: 技术与隐私
items: 技术栈很轻：Python 标准库 + SQLite + 原生 HTML/CSS/JS，没有复杂构建流程，只跑在本机。
数据放在哪：桌面文字和设备记录存在本机 SQLite，照片在附件目录，不是浏览器缓存；桌面数据库、ZIP 和互传包目前没有额外的应用层加密，手机端资料库和手机备份有加密。
联网边界：日常记账、查病历、看趋势完全离线；只有你主动点 AI 分析并确认发送内容后，才会把选中的数据发给对应模型接口。手机端目前不调模型。
博客边界：个人博客只放项目介绍和源码链接，不托管任何个人健康资料，也不对外开放后端。

sections.title: 当前阶段与限制
items: 进度与测试：公开仓库最新提交 9d2b203（仓库版本号仍标为 1.5.0，包含本次 v1.6 全部改动），跨平台 GitHub Actions 6/6 通过，更新日志记录 350 项自动化回归通过（博客这边没有重跑项目测试）。
还在继续验证的地方：不同真实手机的 Apple 健康导出差异、真实模型的医疗整理质量还需要更多日常使用去检验；把运动和饮食摆在同一天只是方便回顾，不是因果推断或健康打分。
医疗底线：不做诊断、不预测得病概率、不开药、不改剂量，也排除不了急症，看病还是得听医生的。
使用提醒：AI 摘录和草稿要对照原件核对，重要检查单别只存这一份，记得自己另留备份。

sectionsEn.title: What it solves
items: Before a follow-up visit, lab results, prescriptions, symptoms, and daily habits are usually scattered across chat logs, photo albums, and paper printouts. Health Journal gathers them locally so you can log day to day and print a clean visit summary when you need one.

It starts blank and stays single-user on your own machine. Device exports, personal notes, original reports, and AI drafts are kept clearly labeled, and missing days stay blank instead of being guessed.

sectionsEn.title: Key features
items: Daily journal and quick meal logging: view meals alongside steps, sleep, heart rate, and walking distance for the same day. Log any meal and attach photos directly—no meal plan or AI call required.

Apple Health import: stream official ZIP/XML exports covering 18 everyday metrics, preview them first, and choose which metrics and dates to save. Multiple device sources are never summed blindly, and missing days stay empty.

Streamlined navigation: trims the old 12-item sidebar into two clear groups—Daily Log (Daily Journal, AI Assistant) and Medical Records (Overview, Visits & Files, Visit Summary)—with Settings & Models tucked at the bottom. All 12 original routes still work.

Opt-in AI with native DeepSeek support: ships with an official DeepSeek preset (deepseek-flash for text + images, deepseek-v4-pro for text) alongside OpenAI, Bailian, SiliconFlow, custom APIs, and local Codex. Every cloud call shows what will be sent and waits for your confirmation, and results stay marked as drafts.

Local backups and an encrypted mobile vault: desktop data lives in local SQLite and an attachments folder with v4 backup/restore; the standalone mobile vault encrypts records in the browser for capturing documents on the go and transferring them manually.

sectionsEn.title: What changed in v1.6
items: Simpler navigation: based on real feedback from friends trying the app, collapsed 12 flat links into Daily Log and Medical Records with clean in-page tabs; moved model settings to the bottom with API key fields up front and local Codex tucked away until needed.
Daily journal and Apple Health imports: builds on the same-day Apple Health ZIP/XML import and standalone meal logging with photo links (no Apple ID, no iCloud, and no live HealthKit sync).

Full DeepSeek official API support: added the DeepSeek preset, string-normalized text messages, disabled thinking mode with json_object output and a 120-second timeout, and replaced generic errors with clear 402/404/422 and empty-response messages.

Hardened state and cleaner UI: tightened backend concurrency locks, removed nested DB connections in FoodJournal.save, added missing-item and deleted-source guards in the frontend, unified the palette to a calmer pine-green theme, and rewrote stiff copy into plain language.

sectionsEn.title: Technology and privacy
items: Lightweight stack: Python standard library, SQLite, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript, running strictly locally.

Where data lives: desktop notes and device samples sit in local SQLite and photos in an attachment folder, not browser cache. Desktop files, ZIP backups, and transfer packages are not application-layer encrypted; the mobile vault and its backups are encrypted.

Network boundaries: everyday logging, searching, and trends work fully offline. Cloud requests happen only when you trigger an AI task and confirm the exact payload; the mobile vault makes no model calls.
Blog boundary: this blog only introduces the project and links to the source repo—it hosts no health data or backend service.

sectionsEn.title: Current scope and limitations
items: Status and tests: checked commit 9d2b203 (the repository package version still reads 1.5.0 while carrying this v1.6 release). Cross-platform GitHub Actions passed 6/6, and the changelog reports 350 passing automated tests (not rerun inside this blog task).

Still being verified: real-device export variations and real-world model output quality need ongoing checks. Showing activity and meals on the same date is for review, not causal analysis or a health score.
Medical boundary: no diagnosis, disease risk prediction, prescribing, dose changes, or emergency screening—always rely on a doctor for medical decisions.
Practical rule: check AI extracts against the original documents and keep separate backups of important records.

brief.title: 项目总管
brief.summary: Track AI-assisted projects with concise next steps, live request status, and milestone timelines in one local dashboard.
brief.summaryZh: 把分散的 AI 项目整理成本地看板，用行动卡、实时请求状态和阶段时间线快速接着做。

entries.title: 项目总管
entries.originalTitle: Project Manager: a local dashboard for AI-assisted work
entries.summary: A local dashboard for Codex and Claude Code with explicit tracking, shared live request status, milestone timelines, and structured next actions. Optional Codex reviews require opt-in, and completion always remains a user decision. The latest maintenance update unifies source development with GitHub while keeping private runtime data separate.
entries.summaryZh: 面向 Codex 和 Claude Code 的本地项目看板，集中展示进度、实时请求、阶段时间线和下一步行动。可选 Codex 自动回读默认关闭，结项由用户决定；本次维护统一源码与 GitHub 的开发入口，让私人运行数据继续留在原处。

sections.title: 解决什么问题
paragraphs: 多个 AI 聊天同时推进时，最难的不是再开一个聊天，而是记清每个项目做到哪了、哪些结果尚未验证、下一次该从哪里继续。项目总管把这些信息整理成短句卡片和阶段时间线。

sections.title: 五个特点
items: 集中跟进：只管理明确加入白名单的项目与聊天，按跟进中、已完成、暂不跟进组织；支持筛选、提醒和置顶，不自动结项。
实时请求状态：Codex 与 Claude 共用猫老大只读 trace 增量订阅，通过 SSE 更新页面；不靠重新请求模型来探测状态，断线时不保留虚假的进行中标记。
阶段时间线：用短结论和分项要点记录想法、调研、决策、实现、验证与阻塞，保留原始详情和操作留痕。
结构化行动卡：集中显示目标、进度、下一步与待确认事项；长原文折叠保留。Claude 记录可按项目、标题及正文检索。
可选自动回读：默认关闭；开启后，只在跟进中的 Codex 聊天整轮结束时分析增量，保留证据与游标，失败不覆盖旧结果。Claude 暂不支持自动回读。

sections.title: 使用与隐私
items: 技术栈：Python 标准库、SQLite、原生 JavaScript，无第三方运行依赖或前端打包流程；面向 macOS / Linux，Windows 使用 WSL。
先体验：提供完全虚构的独立演示，不读取本机聊天、不连接网关、不调用模型；演示与真实数据目录不能混用。
外发边界：状态订阅不调用模型；主动开启自动回读后，所选聊天文本会发送给现有 Codex 配置的模型服务，可能产生费用。
部署边界：Python 服务仅在个人设备的回环地址运行；GitHub Pages 只展示项目介绍，不运行后端，也不暴露真实看板。

sections.title: 本次维护更新
items: 统一源码入口：从关联 GitHub 的同一工作区开发和提交，旧发布副本仅保留作历史快照，不再整目录互相覆盖。
数据仍在原处：通过 --data-dir 复用原私人数据目录，程序、静态页面与模型 schema 从当前源码加载；切换前备份、停旧服务，不同时运行两个分析器。
提交前检查：新增 Git 索引文件检查与可选本机 pre-commit hook，拦截已知数据库、聊天分析、凭据、日志和符号链接。不会自动启用 hook，也不是完整脱敏或安全审计。

sections.title: 兼容范围与限制
items: 请求结束、对话整轮结束、用户验收结项是三个独立状态；HTTP 成功不能当作项目完成。
当前 Codex 适配器依赖本地数据库与 rollout 格式，并筛选 catboss 接入的聊天；Claude 适配器读取本地 JSONL。产品升级后可能需要适配，不承诺支持所有版本或云端会话。
项目提供猫老大接口适配器，不包含网关服务、路由账号、密钥或私人聊天。未进行外部安全认证，不适合作为多用户公网服务。
源码已发布到 GitHub，包含程序、测试、接口说明和虚构演示截图，不含私人聊天或数据库。当前未附加开源许可证，公开可读不等于通用的复制、修改或再分发许可。

sectionsEn.title: Why I built it
paragraphs: When several AI-assisted projects run in parallel, it becomes difficult to remember what changed and where to resume. This dashboard keeps progress, decisions, pending checks, and next actions together.

sectionsEn.title: Five key features
items: Explicit tracking: manage only allowlisted projects and conversations in active, completed, or untracked queues, with filters, reminders, and pinning. Completion always requires the user.

Live request status: Codex and Claude share an incremental read-only CatBoss trace subscription, streamed to the page via SSE. Status checks do not call models, and disconnected state is not presented as a live request.
Milestone timelines: concise conclusions and bullet points cover ideas, research, decisions, implementation, validation, and blockers while retaining original detail and operation history.

Structured action cards: goals, progress, next steps, and pending decisions stay together; long source text is preserved in collapsible sections. Claude records can be searched by project, title, and body.

Optional reviews: disabled by default. Once enabled, incremental reviews run only after completed turns in tracked Codex conversations, preserving evidence and cursors without replacing old results on failure. Claude auto-review is not supported.

sectionsEn.title: Usage and privacy
items: Stack: Python standard library, SQLite, and vanilla JavaScript, with no third-party runtime dependencies or frontend build step. Targets macOS and Linux; Windows users use WSL.
Try it first: a separate fictional demo reads no local conversations, connects to no gateway, and calls no model. Demo and real-data directories cannot be mixed.
Data sharing: status subscriptions do not call models. Opt-in reviews send selected conversation text to the model provider configured in Codex and may incur charges.
Hosting: the Python service runs on a personal device's loopback interface. GitHub Pages presents the project; it does not run the backend or expose the private dashboard.

sectionsEn.title: This maintenance update
items: One source workspace: develop and submit from the GitHub-linked checkout. Old publication copies remain historical snapshots rather than directories to overwrite back and forth.

Data stays in place: use --data-dir for the existing private data directory while code, static assets, and output schema come from the current source. Back up and stop the old service first; do not run two analyzers against the same data.

Pre-commit checks: a Git-index guard and optional local hook reject known databases, analysis files, credentials, logs, and symbolic links. Hooks are not activated automatically, and the guard is not full anonymization or a security audit.

sectionsEn.title: Compatibility and limitations
items: Request completion, conversation-turn completion, and user acceptance are separate states. HTTP success is not project completion.

The Codex adapter depends on local databases and rollout formats and selects conversations using the catboss provider. The Claude adapter reads local JSONL files. Product upgrades may require adaptation; not all versions or cloud conversations are supported.
The project includes the CatBoss adapter, not the gateway service, routing accounts, keys, or private conversations. It has no external security certification and is not a public multi-user service.

The source is published on GitHub with the application, tests, adapter documentation, and a fictional demo screenshot, but no private conversations or databases. It has no open-source license; public readability is not a general grant to copy, modify, or redistribute it.

brief.title: OCSD
brief.summary: Distilling signals from future observations to improve reinforcement learning for agents.
brief.summaryZh: 从后续环境观测中提炼监督信号，改进 Agent 的强化学习训练。

entries.title: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
entries.originalTitle: Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Observation-Calibrated Self-Distillation
entries.summary: OCSD contrasts structurally matched replay views with and without future observations to isolate observation-specific supervision. It uses the resulting residual to modulate token-level GRPO updates at high-uncertainty steps while preserving the trajectory-level update direction.
entries.summaryZh: OCSD 对比包含与移除未来观测、但结构相匹配的回放视图，分离观测本身带来的监督信号，并在高不确定性步骤调整 token 级 GRPO 更新，同时保留轨迹级更新方向。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Preprint available as arXiv:2608.04788. The first version was submitted on August 5, 2026.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: On-policy self-distillation can mix support from privileged future observations with token-score changes caused by the replay scaffold itself. OCSD compares Full and Observation-Ablated replay views to discount shared scaffold effects. The paper reports experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA across three Qwen3 model scales, as well as diagnostic analyses of alignment with local environment feedback.

sections.title: Tasks and Configuration
items: Tasks: ALFWorld, WebShop, and Search-QA.
Model configurations: Qwen3 1.7B, 4B, and 8B.
Code license: Apache License 2.0.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: MultiLCR
brief.summary: Retrieving legal cases through individual defendants' roles and judgment outcomes.
brief.summaryZh: 从被告角色与判决结果出发，让多被告案例检索更贴近法律推理。

entries.title: Beyond Case-Level Similarity: Multi-Defendant Legal Case Retrieval via Individual-Aware Reasoning
entries.originalTitle: Beyond Case-Level Similarity: Multi-Defendant Legal Case Retrieval via Individual-Aware Reasoning
entries.summary: MultiLCR studies legal case retrieval beyond case-level textual similarity by modeling defendants' roles and judgment outcomes. It introduces the Multi-ELAM and Multi-LeCaRDv2 datasets with defendant-level annotations and a role- and judgment-aware retrieval framework.
entries.summaryZh: MultiLCR 通过建模被告角色与判决结果，让法律案例检索超越整案文本相似度。论文构建了带有被告级标注的 Multi-ELAM 和 Multi-LeCaRDv2 数据集，并提出角色与判决感知的检索框架。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 main conference and published in the conference proceedings (October 2026).
ACL Anthology ID: 2026.emnlp-main.1918. Pages: 43688–43713. Publisher: Association for Computational Linguistics. DOI: 10.18653/2026.emnlp-main.1918.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Surface-level textual matching can overlook the distinct roles and judgment outcomes of defendants in multi-defendant cases. The paper enriches existing benchmarks with defendant-level annotations and proposes a role- and judgment-aware framework. Its abstract reports improvements over state-of-the-art baselines for multi-defendant legal case retrieval.

sections.title: Resource Availability
items: The Multi-LCR dataset is available on Hugging Face.
See the GitHub repository for code availability and setup instructions.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: SelSkill
brief.summary: Teaching agents when to invoke a reusable skill—and when to skip it.
brief.summaryZh: 让 Agent 学会何时调用技能、何时跳过，而不是一味增加技能调用。

entries.title: Skill or Skip? Learning Selective Skill Invocation in Agentic Tasks via Dual-Granularity Preference Learning
entries.originalTitle: Skill or Skip? Learning Selective Skill Invocation in Agentic Tasks via Dual-Granularity Preference Learning
entries.summary: SelSkill learns when an agent should invoke a reusable skill and when it should skip it. It combines episode-level and step-level preference learning with controlled invoke-or-skip comparisons to improve selective skill use in agentic tasks.
entries.summaryZh: SelSkill 研究 Agent 何时应调用可复用技能、何时应跳过，通过控制调用与跳过的对照轨迹，结合任务级和步骤级偏好学习，提升技能调用的选择性。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026 and published in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026 (October 2026).
ACL Anthology ID: 2026.findings-emnlp.222. Pages: 4665–4681. DOI: 10.18653/2026.findings-emnlp.222.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Reusable skills can help agents, but indiscriminate invocation can be counterproductive. SelSkill prioritizes uncertain decision points and constructs invoke-or-skip preference pairs that share the same trajectory prefix. It combines episode-level outcomes with step-level signals to train selective skill invocation.

sections.title: Evaluation
paragraphs: The paper evaluates selective skill invocation on ALFWorld and BFCL, with additional zero-shot transfer experiments on Tau-bench and PopQA.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: LawShift
brief.summary: Testing whether judgment prediction models adapt when statutes change.
brief.summaryZh: 当法条发生修订，检验司法预测模型能否相应调整判断。

entries.title: LawShift: Benchmarking Legal Judgment Prediction Under Statute Shifts
entries.originalTitle: LawShift: Benchmarking Legal Judgment Prediction Under Statute Shifts
entries.summary: LawShift benchmarks legal judgment prediction under statutory revisions. Covering 31 fine-grained change types, it uses metamorphic testing to examine whether models adapt their judgments to changes in the law.
entries.summaryZh: LawShift 评估法律条文修订下的司法判决预测能力，覆盖 31 类细粒度法条变化，通过蜕变测试检查模型能否随法律变化调整判决。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Accepted to the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track as a poster and published in the conference proceedings.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Legal judgment prediction models need to account for statutory revisions rather than rely on a static view of the law. LawShift introduces a Chinese legal benchmark covering 31 fine-grained revision types. Its metamorphic testing framework examines expected relationships between predictions before and after a statute changes.

sections.title: Evaluation
paragraphs: The paper evaluates five representative legal judgment prediction models, revealing limitations in their response to legal updates and differences in adaptability across model architectures.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: LAWRE
brief.summary: Looking beyond recall to diagnose practical legal reasoning in case retrieval.
brief.summaryZh: 不只看召回率，用诊断性测试评估案例检索中的法律推理能力。

entries.title: LAWRE: Evaluating Legal Case Retrieval for Practical Legal Reasoning
entries.originalTitle: LAWRE: Evaluating Legal Case Retrieval for Practical Legal Reasoning
entries.summary: LAWRE evaluates whether legal case retrieval systems possess the reasoning skills needed in practice, beyond high recall on existing benchmarks. It provides diagnostic tests for capabilities such as distinguishing easily confused cases and identifying legal elements.
entries.summaryZh: LAWRE 面向法律实践评估案例检索系统，关注易混淆案例区分、法律要素识别等推理能力，而不只看召回率，并通过诊断性测试分析模型短板。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Accepted to the 2026 International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN) and published in its proceedings, pages 1–6. The conference took place on June 22–26, 2026, in Maastricht, Netherlands.
DOI: 10.1109/IJCNN69854.2026.11728674. The paper was added to IEEE Xplore on October 19, 2026.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Strong retrieval scores do not necessarily demonstrate the legal reasoning required for practical use. LAWRE introduces a benchmark that probes these capabilities and provides detailed diagnostic feedback on legal case retrieval systems.

sections.title: Evaluation
paragraphs: The paper evaluates eight representative retrieval models, identifying weaknesses that can guide the development of more practically effective legal case retrieval systems.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: QR-LJP
brief.summary: Using monetary reasoning to better connect case facts with sentencing.
brief.summaryZh: 把涉案金额的定量推理引入判决预测，更好地连接案情与量刑。

entries.title: Improving Legal Judgment Prediction via Quantitative Reasoning
entries.originalTitle: Improving Legal Judgment Prediction via Quantitative Reasoning

publication.venue: ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data (TKDD)

entries.summary: QR-LJP incorporates legal quantitative reasoning into judgment prediction. It extracts monetary values from case facts, determines the total crime amount using legal reasoning, and uses this measure of crime severity to improve judgment predictions, particularly prison terms.
entries.summaryZh: QR-LJP 将法律定量推理引入司法判决预测：从案情中提取金额，依据法律规则计算犯罪总金额，再用量化的犯罪严重程度辅助判决，尤其是刑期预测。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Published in ACM Transactions on Knowledge Discovery from Data (TKDD) on May 19, 2026. Volume 20, Issue 4, Article 66, pages 1–42.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: Monetary features can be critical for assessing crime severity, yet models may overlook their legal significance. QR-LJP uses a domain-adapted language model to extract relevant amounts and perform quantitative reasoning. The resulting crime amount is aligned with legal knowledge to support judgment prediction.

sections.title: Evaluation
paragraphs: The study evaluates legal judgment prediction on CAIL-2018 and examines how quantitative reasoning improves existing methods, with particular attention to prison term prediction.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: FutureBridge-OPD
brief.summary: Validating teacher guidance through the student's future trajectory before distillation.
brief.summaryZh: 先观察学生后续轨迹是否改善，再决定保留哪些教师指导用于蒸馏。

entries.title: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
entries.originalTitle: Look Ahead Before You Distill: Future Trajectory Validation of Teacher Guidance for Agentic On-Policy Distillation
entries.summary: FutureBridge-OPD (FTB) validates teacher guidance through the future trajectories it induces in the student. At a state with high teacher-student disagreement, it executes a short teacher bridge and compares student continuations from the original and bridged states. The bridge is retained for distillation only when the resulting continuation is more strongly preferred by the teacher.
entries.summaryZh: FutureBridge-OPD（FTB）通过教师指导所引出的学生后续轨迹，判断指导是否值得蒸馏。在师生分歧较大的状态插入短暂的教师引导，并比较原状态与引导后状态下的学生续写；只有后者更符合教师偏好时，才保留该引导用于蒸馏。

sections.title: Publication
paragraphs: Preprint available as arXiv:2608.01953. The first version was submitted on August 3, 2026, and the latest listed revision (v2) was submitted on August 5, 2026.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: In multi-turn agentic on-policy distillation, student errors can accumulate and move later states away from regions where teacher guidance is useful. High teacher-student disagreement identifies promising intervention points, but does not by itself show that an intervention will help. FutureBridge-OPD validates a candidate teacher bridge by examining its effect on subsequent student behavior before retaining it for distillation.

sections.title: Evaluation
paragraphs: The paper evaluates FTB on ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld. Under the main Qwen3-32B teacher to Qwen3-1.7B student setting, it reports average improvements of 16.6 and 7.6 points over vanilla OPD and TCOD, respectively, with additional experiments across student scales and teacher settings.

entries.sourceNote: Publication metadata follows the linked paper and official repository.

brief.title: 个人技术博客
brief.summary: A lightweight bilingual blog on GitHub Pages, bringing papers, projects, notes, and research updates together.
brief.summaryZh: 基于 GitHub Pages 的轻量双语博客，把论文、项目、笔记与最新进展放在一起。

entries.title: 个人技术博客
entries.summary: The site you are reading is also a small software project: a bilingual technical blog built with a lightweight Node.js static generator and deployed on GitHub Pages. It organizes papers, projects, notes, and news around shared content and stable routes, without requiring a database or server application.
entries.summaryZh: 这个网站本身也是一个小型软件项目：使用轻量的 Node.js 静态生成器，把论文、项目、笔记和动态组织成独立的中英文页面，通过 GitHub Pages 发布。重点是内容清晰、链接稳定、便于持续维护，不需要数据库或后端服务。

sections.title: 为什么做这个网站
paragraphs: 相比只放个人履历，我更希望有一个持续积累研究与实践的地方：论文说明方法和成果，项目记录实现与使用方式，笔记容纳阅读和调研，首页动态交代最近发生了什么。
本页介绍的是现有博客的实现方式，不是另一个新建网站。源代码复用同一个博客仓库，内容更新与代码修改都保留版本记录。

sections.title: 五个特点
items: 轻量静态生成：使用 Node.js 和原生 HTML/CSS，构建不依赖第三方包；阅读和导航不依赖客户端脚本。
独立双语页面：项目与笔记分别维护中文和英文标题、摘要、正文及资源名称，切换语言仍对应当前文章；论文按既定规则保留英文原名和详情。
统一内容与链接：文章集中维护，外部地址通过全局链接表复用，内部跳转通过稳定的 slug 和路由 key 生成，避免每页单独维护链接。
分类与动态分开：论文、项目、笔记各有列表；首页展示简要介绍和最近五条动态，“更多动态”保留完整历史，新近内容优先显示。
检查后自动部署：GitHub Actions 先构建并检查页面、双语路由和站内链接，成功后再发布生成文件；Pull Request 只验证，不直接更新正式站。

sections.title: 内容如何维护
items: 当前内容源是 content.json，Markdown 可作为写作和交接素材，但还不会直接导入并渲染成文章。
新增项目时整理简短首页介绍、独立的中英文详情和可选动态；先本地预览，确认后提交，避免把一篇完整说明堆到首页。
标题可以调整，已发布的 slug 和资源 key 尽量保持稳定；所有历史论文和动态都保留，不因新增条目而覆盖旧资料。

sections.title: 隐私与能力边界
items: 提供可关闭的 GoatCounter 访问统计接入；仅在正式域名加载，尊重浏览器隐私偏好，本地预览不请求第三方统计脚本。
统计用于观察去重访问趋势，不代表精确人数，也不能补回启用前的流量。
这是公开的静态内容站点，不提供登录、评论、数据库或运行项目后端的能力；不存放私人健康档案、聊天记录或账号凭证。
自动检查有助于发现缺失翻译和站内链接问题，但不能代替事实核实或保证所有外部链接始终有效。

sectionsEn.title: Why I built it
paragraphs: Rather than maintaining only a personal resume, I wanted a place for research and practical work to accumulate: papers explain methods and results, projects document implementations, notes capture reading and research, and homepage updates highlight recent changes.
This page describes the existing blog, not a second website. It uses the same source repository, with version history for both content and code changes.

sectionsEn.title: Five key features
items: Lightweight static generation: Node.js and vanilla HTML/CSS, with no third-party build packages. Reading and navigation do not depend on client-side scripts.

Separate language pages: projects and notes have independently maintained Chinese and English titles, summaries, bodies, and resource labels. Switching languages stays on the same article; papers retain their original English titles and details.

Shared content and links: articles use a central content source, external URLs are registered once, and internal links are generated from stable slugs and route keys instead of being maintained page by page.

Categories and news: papers, projects, and notes have their own lists. The homepage shows brief introductions and five recent updates, while the full history preserves older news with recent content first.
Validated deployment: GitHub Actions builds and checks pages, bilingual routes, and internal links before publishing generated files. Pull requests run validation without deploying the live site.

sectionsEn.title: Maintaining content
items: The current content source is content.json. Markdown can serve as writing and handoff material but is not yet imported and rendered directly as articles.

A new project gets a brief homepage introduction, separate Chinese and English detail pages, and optional news. Changes are previewed locally before approval and submission, keeping long explanations off the homepage.
Titles can change while published slugs and resource keys remain stable. Adding an entry does not remove existing papers or news history.

sectionsEn.title: Privacy and scope
items: Optional GoatCounter integration loads only on the production origin and respects browser privacy preferences. Local previews do not request the third-party analytics script.
Statistics indicate deduplicated visit trends, not exact people, and cannot recover traffic from before activation.
This is a public static content site, not a login system, comment service, database, or project-backend host. It stores no private health records, conversations, or account credentials.
Automated checks help detect missing translations and broken internal links; they do not replace fact checking or guarantee that external resources remain available.

updates.text: 个人健康助理项目「知己 · 健康手记」源码已公开：以可追溯的本地档案整理就诊、检查与症状，结合按次授权的 AI 草稿和手机加密资料库，帮助准备就医信息；不用于诊断、开药或替代医生判断。
updates.textEn: Published the source of Health Journal, a personal health assistant that organizes visits, reports, and symptoms in traceable local records, with opt-in AI drafts and an encrypted mobile document vault. It helps prepare information for medical visits, not diagnose, prescribe, or replace professional judgment.

updates.text: 新增「项目总管」介绍：把 Codex 与 Claude Code 中分散的工作整理成本地看板，用实时请求状态、阶段时间线和结构化行动卡记录进度与下一步。可选自动回读默认关闭，项目是否完成始终由用户确认。11 月 25 日维护补充：统一源码维护入口，保留私人数据原位置，并增加提交前 Git 索引隐私检查。
updates.textEn: Added Project Manager, a local dashboard for Codex and Claude Code with live request status, milestone timelines, and structured next-action cards. Optional reviews are disabled by default, and completion requires user confirmation. Maintenance note, November 25: unified source development, kept private data in place, and added pre-commit checks of the Git index.

updates.text: MultiLCR 面向多被告法律案例检索，结合各被告的角色与判决结果进行个体感知推理，而不只比较整案文本相似度。相关论文发表于 EMNLP 2026 主会。
updates.textEn: MultiLCR retrieves multi-defendant legal cases by reasoning about each defendant’s role and judgment outcome, beyond case-level textual similarity. The paper is published in the EMNLP 2026 main conference proceedings.

updates.text: SelSkill 通过任务级与步骤级偏好学习，让 Agent 学会何时调用可复用技能、何时跳过，避免不必要的技能调用。相关论文发表于 Findings of EMNLP 2026。
updates.textEn: SelSkill combines episode-level and step-level preference learning to teach agents when to invoke reusable skills and when to skip them. The paper is published in Findings of EMNLP 2026.

updates.text: OCSD 从后续环境观测中提炼监督信号，通过观测校准的自蒸馏改进 Agent 强化学习中的 token 级更新。预印本已上线 arXiv。
updates.textEn: OCSD distills supervision from future environment observations, using observation-calibrated self-distillation to refine token-level updates in agentic reinforcement learning. The preprint is available on arXiv.

updates.text: QR-LJP 将涉案金额的定量推理引入司法判决预测，依据法律规则计算犯罪金额，辅助判决与刑期预测。相关论文发表于 ACM TKDD。
updates.textEn: QR-LJP brings quantitative reasoning about monetary values into legal judgment prediction, using legally grounded crime amounts to support judgment and prison-term predictions. The paper is published in ACM TKDD.

updates.text: FutureBridge-OPD 在师生分歧较大的状态引入教师指导，再用学生后续轨迹验证指导是否有效，只保留更符合教师偏好的引导用于蒸馏。预印本已上线 arXiv，代码已开源。
updates.textEn: FutureBridge-OPD introduces teacher guidance at high-disagreement states and validates it through subsequent student trajectories, retaining bridges that lead to more teacher-preferred continuations. The preprint is available on arXiv, and the code is open source.

updates.text: LawShift 评估法律条文修订下的司法判决预测能力，覆盖 31 类细粒度法条变化，检验模型能否随法律变化调整判断。相关论文获 NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track 接收。
updates.textEn: LawShift evaluates legal judgment prediction under statutory revisions, covering 31 fine-grained change types to test whether models adapt their judgments when the law changes. The paper was accepted to the NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.

updates.text: 知己 · 健康手记更新到 v1.6：除了把 Apple 健康导出的步数、睡眠和日常饮食放到同一天里看、随手记一餐贴照片，这次还按朋友试用反馈把 12 个侧边栏入口收拢成了「日常记录」和「医疗档案」两大块，补齐了 DeepSeek 官方 API 适配，也把前后端并发状态和界面文案都打磨了一遍。还是纯本地工具，不看病不开药。
updates.textEn: Health Journal is now at v1.6: alongside viewing Apple Health ZIP/XML exports and daily meals (with photos) on the same day, this update trims the 12-item sidebar down to Daily Log and Medical Records, adds native DeepSeek API support, and polishes concurrency handling and UI copy. Still strictly local, and not for diagnosis or prescriptions.

updates.text: 新增「个人技术博客」项目介绍，记录这个网站如何通过静态生成、独立双语页面和统一链接管理组织论文、项目与笔记，并利用 GitHub Actions 检查和部署；附现有博客源码入口。
updates.textEn: Added Personal Technical Blog, an introduction to how this site uses static generation, separate language pages, and shared links to organize papers, projects, and notes, with GitHub Actions for validation and deployment. The existing blog source is linked from the article.
